freeze_rule: Do not relax cases or thresholds after measurement. Preserve failed checks; code execution and numerical quality are separate verdicts. Existing #193 evidence remains dual-input evidence.
feature_parity_cases: C1-C4, all 16 dinucleotide pairs tiled across 34 bases, and N at each of the 34 positions of C1; all 354 features per case

continuous_extension.layout: ACGT channels; protospacer = x[8:31]; GC total = sum(p[:,1:3])/23; GC tail = sum(p[-8:,1:3])/8; pair[i,b,c] = p[i,b]*p[i+1,c]; flatten position, first base, second base; prepend GC total and tail
continuous_extension.baseline: x0=0 in all 34x4 channels; D(0)=0 in all 354 features; baseline is not a DNA sequence
continuous_extension.composite: F(x)=M(x,D(x)); dF/dx = partial M/partial x + J_D(x)^T partial M/partial D; path = (alpha*x,D(alpha*x)), with linear GC and alpha^2 dinucleotides
continuous_extension.dual: G(x,z)=M(x,z); path = (alpha*x,alpha*D(x)); dinucleotides scale with alpha; sequence attribution is partial, and only the signed sum over both inputs is complete

settings.ig_rule: midpoint; float32 model, float64 gradient/attribution accumulation
settings.soft_fixture: float64 x[p,b] = (((4*p+b)*7)%19+1)/20 for all 34x4 entries; deliberately not one-hot or normalized

criteria.finiteness: All measured outputs, gradients, attributions and diagnostics finite

comparison_rule: Run both paths at the same cases, alphas and IG resolutions. Never gate on per-position agreement BETWEEN paths. Prefer composite for the single-sequence screen if feature parity, soft gradient, chain rule and endpoint/function checks establish feasibility. Record FD, completeness and resolution failures without treating 256 steps as a new default or biological validation.

screen_contract.composite: 34 signed per-position contributions, including the derived-feature chain; their sum explains unclipped M(x,D(x))-M(0,0). No separate feature attribution or biological importance ratio.
screen_contract.dual_if_retained: Label sequence contributions as partial. Expose signed sequence total, signed derived-feature total and joint completeness; never redistribute feature contributions to bases.
screen_contract.units: IGResult remains raw probability; presentation multiplies prediction/baseline by 100 to percent and contributions/error by 100 to percentage points. Explain before table clipping.
screen_contract.display_policy: Preserve computable graphs and prediction table; numerical failures go to internal evidence with no separate quality warning. Exceptions/no-result/NaN/inf retain existing error handling. Precision is explicit and optional.
screen_contract.limitations: Zero and soft inputs are not real DNA; independent channel perturbations are a mathematical extension. PAM can vary on the path. Attribution depends on baseline and path and is not biological causality.

identity: family + actual checkpoint SHA + protocol (path, feature definition, baseline, integration and raw unit) + runtime versions/dtype/threads; existing cache adds head/window/steps or SHAP settings/seeds. Unverified runtime has no cache identity.
out_of_scope: Production predictor/UI wiring and optional precision controls belong to #200. NT units to #201. Whole-tree RAM and final offline packaging to #203/#204. No new SHAP quality claim or biological study.
